THE UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND COLLEGEOF THINKBIG WEDO" ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRICAL,COMPUTER AND BIOMEDICAL ENGINEERING F as cite lli Centerfor Advanced Engineering,2East Alumni Ave,Kingston，RI02881 Dear Dean Marchese I am writing to report the faculty voting results regarding the proposal for Biomedical Engineering (BME) to become a standalone department, as well as the request for a department name change should the proposal be approved.
On September 8, 2025, the Department of Electrical, Computer, and Biomedical Engineering (ECBE) convened a faculty meeting.
A total of 22 faculty members participated in the vote.
Of these, 20 were present in person, while two faculty members, who were unable to attend due to scheduling conflicts, cast their votes remotely during the meeting time.
In addition, you and Professor Emeritus Ramada Kumaresan attended the meeting as non-voting participants.

The faculty unanimously supported the following actions: (a) Initiating the process to seek approval for the Biomedical Engineering program to become the Department of Biomedical Engineering (BME). (b) Renaming the current ECBE department as the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE), contingent upon the establishment of BME as a separate department.
This decision was based on the vision for the future Biomedical Engineering department and the department-level resource allocation plan presented during the meeting.
Thank you for your continued leadership and support as we take this important step toward advancing the college's long-term vision.
This collective faculty decision reflects our readiness to support the next stages of the process under your guidance.
Sincerely, Yan (Lindsay) Sun, Ph.D., IEEE Fellow Professor and Chair, Electrical, Computer, and Biomedical Engineering University of Rhode Island Sept 8, 2025 The University fh odes and is an equal opportunity m lo yer committed to community equity and dvr s it y

THE UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND COLLEGEOF THINKBIG WEDO" ENGINEERING OFFICE OF THE DEAN Bliss Hall,Suite490,1Lippitt Road,Kingston,RI02881USAp:401.874.2186 January 29, 2026 Yan (Lindsay) Sun, Ph.D., IEEE Fellow Professor & Chair, Electrical, Computer, and Biomedical Engineering Co-Director,Center for Cyber-Physical Intelligence and Security(CYPHER) College of Engineering, University of Rhode Island, Kingston, RI 02881 Dear Yan: The purpose of this letter is to provide my strongest support for your proposal to change the name of the Department of Electrical, Computer and Biomedical Engineering (ECBE) to the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE).
ECBE Department faculty - to create a new Department of Biomedical Engineering (BME).

The Biomedical Engineering program is currently housed within the Department of Electrical, Computer and Biomedical Engineering, and it is comprised of a group of faculty members who perform biomedical engineering research and oversee the undergraduate B.S. in Biomedical Engineering, which is one of eight ABET accredited B.S. spin out as a separate department.The ECBE faculty unanimously voted to support initiating the formal approval process for BME to become a separate department.
A vote was then held among all COE faculty, which was overwhelmingly positive.A proposal to establish the new BME Department was submitted to the Faculty Senate on January 28, 2026.
Upon establishment of the new Department of Biomedical Engineering, the existing name of the Department of Electrical, Computer and Biomedical Engineering needs to be updated to reflect the movement of the Biomedical Engineering faculty and academic programs into the new department.
Accordingly, I fully support this proposal to rename EC BE Department.
My support for the proposed name change is contingent upon approval and establishment of the new BME Department.
Sincerely, Anthony J.Marchese,Ph.D.
